import datetime,hashlib,json,os,pathlib,signal,subprocess,time
out=pathlib.Path('simulations/outputs/rich6d_rough_sr3_extended_v2')
record=out/'production_after_checkpoint_stop.json'
def now(): return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
def write(path,data):
 tmp=path.with_name(path.name+'.tmp')
 tmp.write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n')
 os.replace(tmp,path)
state=dict(status='waiting_for_completed_checkpoint',watcher_pid=os.getpid(),target_pid=39867,target_index=286,started_utc=now(),reason='Disk reserve fell from about 8 GiB to about 4 GiB while shared-host runtimes lengthened. Return to one production worker after preserving the current supplement result.',scientific_protocol_unchanged=True)
write(record,state)
checkpoint=out/'production_baseline/P4096/rep_286.npz'
resources=out/'production_baseline/resources_286.json'
while True:
 command=subprocess.run(['ps','-p','39867','-o','command='],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
 if 'production_recovery_batch_287_268.json' not in command:
  state.update(status='target_exited_before_stop',finished_utc=now(),checkpoint_present=checkpoint.exists())
  write(record,state)
  break
 if checkpoint.exists() and resources.exists():
  r=json.loads(resources.read_text())
  assert r['index']==286 and r['run_hash']=='e9f1f005be1a58ee736a09cb711d5be87457b9875d1e26dab56c03ccdca61d8d'
  state.update(checkpoint_sha256=hashlib.sha256(checkpoint.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),checkpoint_completed_utc=r['completed_utc'])
  os.kill(39867,signal.SIGTERM)
  for _ in range(100):
   live=subprocess.run(['ps','-p','39867','-o','stat='],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
   if not live or live.startswith('Z'): break
   time.sleep(.1)
  else: raise RuntimeError('Supplement did not exit after SIGTERM; inspect before taking any further action.')
  batch_path=out/'production_recovery_batch_287_268.json'
  batch=json.loads(batch_path.read_text())
  completed=[i for i in batch['indices'] if (out/'production_baseline/P4096'/f'rep_{i:03d}.npz').exists() and (out/'production_baseline'/f'resources_{i:03d}.json').exists()]
  batch.update(status='stopped_after_completed_checkpoint_resource_reduction',completed_indices=completed,pending_indices=[i for i in batch['indices'] if i not in completed],stopped_utc=now(),stop_record=record.name,note='The saved checkpoints remain subject to the independent integrity audit. Any newly entered next replication was stopped before completion; every missing index remains in the primary deterministic queue.')
  write(batch_path,batch)
  state.update(status='stopped_after_checkpoint_saved',finished_utc=now(),remaining_total_production_workers=1)
  write(record,state)
  print('Supplement stopped after checkpoint 286 was saved; primary supervisor continues.',flush=True)
  break
 time.sleep(.25)
